# Muhammad Owais Ahmed

> Muhammad Owais Ahmed (handle: codewithowais) is a Senior Software Engineer based in Karachi, Pakistan, with 6 years of experience building production web and mobile applications across Angular, React, Node.js, .NET and Flutter. He is a founding engineer at the EdTech platform SimpliEd (25,000+ users), a Flutter instructor who has trained 1,200+ students at Jawan Pakistan, and a freelance developer available for hire.
